data.title: How to actually detect overtrading
data.subtitle: Not a gut feeling. A formula.

steps.label: 1. Log your trades/day for a month
steps.description: You need your real per-day count, not a guess

steps.label: 3. Find the standard deviation
steps.description: How much your daily count actually swings

steps.label: 4. Threshold = average + 1 std dev
steps.description: Anything above this isn't a busy day — it's a spike

steps.label: 5. Flag every day that crosses it
steps.description: MB Trade Lab does this automatically, then shows your win rate on those flagged days
